hypothesis: The unchanged D0-H32-s14000 parent yields enough wholly new trial8..11 successes to build a fresh ranking validation set after C30 missed its preregistered validation mixed-group threshold by one.
single_variable: Only LIBERO benchmark initial-state trial index changes from C29 trials4..7 to never-consumed trials8..11; checkpoint, action path, task inventory, seeds, replan8 and no-ensemble stay fixed.
parent_baseline: C29 trials4..7 yielded 61/160 successful sources; C30 then produced 25 train but only 3 validation mixed groups against a fixed requirement of 4, so C30 formally failed and no C31 training launched.

decision.rationale: C30 is retained as a failed preregistered experiment; new trial8..11 sources are the shortest unbiased route to a genuinely fresh ranking validation set.
